HPX_PRINTERS_DETAILS.py.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android test automation page class for the HP Smart mobile app. It extends SmartFlow and provides structured methods for interacting with the HP printer details screen. The class enables navigation to printer tiles (scan, print, copy, fax, shortcuts), product information retrieval, printer configuration, and report generation. It implements swipe-and-find patterns for UI elements with configurable retry and timeout handling. Both verification and action methods are included for printer features, supporting end-to-end testing scenarios.
